evidence: risks related to our use of artificial intelligence (AI), and challenges with properly managing such use

Cyber threats are constantly evolving, especially given the advances in, and the rise of the use of, artificial intelligence, thereby increasing the difficulty of preventing, detecting and successfully defending against them
risks related to security breaches, cybersecurity attacks, failure to protect personal information
ai_positioning.summary: URI adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, mettant l'accent sur les risques de cybersécurité amplifiés par les avancées en IA et les défis de gestion appropriée de cette technologie, sans mention d'initiatives propres de développement ou d'intégration.
